Who We Are

Precision-driven
Brass Manufacturing

A dedicated manufacturer and supplier of premium brass extruded products, operating from Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.

We specialize in a comprehensive range of brass extruded rods, billets, ingots, and custom profiles engineered to exacting international standards. Our products serve industries spanning electrical, plumbing, hardware, automotive, and precision engineering.

Every product that leaves our facility undergoes strict quality inspection, ensuring dimensional accuracy, consistent alloy composition, and superior surface finish that our clients have come to rely on.

How We Work

Our Manufacturing
Process

Every piece of brass we produce goes through a carefully controlled, multi-stage manufacturing process — ensuring dimensional accuracy, alloy integrity, and a superior surface finish from start to finish.

01

Raw Material Sourcing

We procure only high-grade copper and zinc ingots from certified suppliers. Every batch is accompanied by a material test certificate (MTC) confirming chemical composition before it enters our facility.

02

Alloy Preparation & Melting

Copper and zinc are weighed and blended in precise ratios to achieve the target alloy grade — IS 319, CW614N, HTB, or custom grades. Melting is carried out in induction furnaces at tightly controlled temperatures to prevent zinc loss and ensure chemical uniformity throughout the melt.

03

Billet Casting

The molten brass is cast into cylindrical billets using controlled-cooling moulds. Casting speed and temperature are monitored to achieve a fine, homogeneous grain structure — critical for consistent extrusion performance and mechanical properties.

04

Billet Heating & Hot Extrusion

Billets are heated to optimal extrusion temperature in gas-fired furnaces. They are then loaded into the extrusion press where a hydraulic ram forces the hot brass through precision-machined steel dies — forming rods, flats, hexagonals, hollows, and custom profiles to exact dimensions.

05

Cooling, Straightening & Cutting

Extruded sections are cooled on run-out tables under controlled conditions to prevent warping. Straightening machines ensure perfectly linear profiles, and precision saws cut the material to the required lengths with clean, burr-free ends.

06

Quality Inspection & Dispatch

Every batch undergoes rigorous inspection: dimensional checks with calibrated gauges, spectroscopic alloy verification, surface quality assessment, and hardness testing where specified. Only material that meets our standards is cleared for packaging and timely dispatch to the customer.
